Hey Katie / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — good overview of your ingestion patterns and latency expectations. Quick recap + next steps so we can lock the technical deep-dive (dedicated capacity sizing):

Summary of what we heard
- Workload: real-time analytics for customer-facing recommendations; average request = ~1.5k tokens; 95th pct request ~3.5k tokens.
- Current peak: ~1.2k concurrent requests, expected growth to ~3k in 6 months.
- Key SLOs: p95 generation latency <= 150ms; sustained throughput target ~60k tokens/minute with headroom for short bursts.

Proposed next step
- 45-minute technical deep-dive with our Solutions team to size a Dedicated pool (throughput, batching, KV cache, quantization profile). We'll come with a baseline capacity estimate and a short checklist for your infra/security team.

Proposed slots (Pacific):
- Tue 10/13, 10:00–10:45am PT
- Wed 10/14, 2:00–2:45pm PT
- Thu 10/15, 9:30–10:15am PT

Agenda (30–45m):
1) Quick recap of traffic shape & SLOs (5m)
2) Latency & batching considerations (10m)
3) Sizing walk-through (Baseline GPU pools, throughput curves) (15m)
4) Next steps: access/credentials, compliance docs, scheduling pilot (5–10m)

Attachments: I’ve attached a short capacity template (capacity-template.xlsx) — if you can drop in a representative day of traffic or peak-minute stats it will speed up the sizing exercise.

If you prefer, use this link to pick a time: https://calendly.com/redwood/dedicated-sizing-30m

Thanks — will loop Monica into the call (she’ll lead the sizing).

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
